# Nyang Cleaners

> Laundry, carpet, mattress, sofa and office cleaning with pickup and delivery in Nairobi, Kisumu, Eldoret, Nakuru and Mombasa, Kenya.

Prices are in KES: laundry from KES 250/kg (wash & fold), carpets from KES 1,000, mattresses from KES 800, sofas from KES 2,000, office cleaning from KES 40/sqm. Standard turnaround 48 hours, express 24 hours. Pay by cash or M-Pesa. Order on WhatsApp: +254 706 460395 (https://wa.me/254706460395).
